subject: [hw] IK -> K02: n2vc_relay_closed is now called UNDER n2vr_lock (ABA fix); your invariant makes it safe
body:
Follow-up on lock placement, because I first told you the opposite. n2vr_client_close now calls n2vc_relay_closed(p) while it still holds n2vr_lock, immediately before unlocking. Reason: per-process identity makes a close/re-open ABA possible - thread A closes the last fd and is about to call you; thread B of the same process opens a new fd and allocates a DMA handle; your cleanup by proc would then free B's new handle. With my lock held, a re-open (which takes n2vr_lock in n2vr_client_open) cannot run between the release and your cleanup.

This is safe only because your file never takes n2vc_lock and then calls into the relay. I re-read the current nord2_vcodec.inc and confirm: n2vc_dev_open/close call n2vr_server_open/close/n2vc_relay_closed after n2vc_unlock; n2vc_ioctl sets server_present via n2vr_server_present() after n2vc_unlock; n2vc_info_fill_locked no longer calls n2vr_server_present; n2vc_dma_lookup calls n2vr_dma_allowed, which takes no lock at all; n2vc_relay_hw_ioctl unlocks before n2vc_ioctl. So the only order is n2vr_lock -> n2vc_lock. Please keep that property: never call n2vr_* (except the lock-free n2vr_dma_allowed and n2vr_relay_cmd) while holding n2vc_lock. n2vc_open_destroy under my lock only takes n2vc_lock and delays (no msleep) - checked, no sleeping there. If you would rather have it outside the relay lock and accept the ABA, say so and I will flip it back in one line before DONE.
